what: The Midterm Slate 2026 — the register, derived from Parameters/09_Parallelograms/Midterm_Slate_2026.md (canonical; update both). Each row is a prediction stated BEFORE election day, with the object it rides on and what would mark it missed. Outcomes are filled after 2026-11-03 and never revised. Testers call each one (held / missed) under their avatar; the calls are public (data/slate/calls/).

rows.object: The Iran war — the delegation and the force
rows.prediction: The populist stations stay silent on the instrument (the sanctions/tariff delegation) and loud on the force (the war) — vacancy at the moment. If LP or RP engages the delegation itself before 11-03, the arc records the miss.
rows.missedIf: A populist station (LP or RP) engages the delegation itself before 11-03.

rows.body: none yet — a bill 'after the midterms'; reconciliation named as the vehicle
rows.prediction: No bill text before 11-03; the number is repeated at every rally; the peel widens (more RI center) if a CBO/JCT score lands.

rows.object: The $2,000 tariff dividend — promised 2025, never enacted
rows.body: a void — the body is the absence
rows.prediction: The President does not mention it again before 11-03; LI mentions it as the precedent.
rows.missedIf: The President repeats the $2,000 promise before 11-03.

rows.prediction: No floor vote in either chamber before 11-03; the object is used as a campaign predicate by both populist stations without a body.
rows.missedIf: A floor vote is held in either chamber before 11-03.

rows.object: The institutional-investor housing ban — the delivered control
rows.body: the ROAD to Housing Act, Public Law 119-101, law 07-11 without signature
rows.prediction: It disappears from the discourse precisely because it passed — vacancy by delivery.
rows.missedIf: Coverage of the ban rises into the campaign's final weeks (GDELT volume on the object climbs).

rows.prediction: No standalone Reading; it is the detector for the war funding and the deficit objects.
rows.missedIf: The cliff becomes its own object with a split of its own.

rows.object: The tariff refunds — the binding layer
rows.prediction: It stays invisible in campaign discourse while being the largest fiscal fact on the slate — post-detection unreadability on a domestic object.
rows.missedIf: The refund becomes a campaign object: a principal names it at a rally, or coverage volume climbs.

rows.body: unknown — reported as the second of 'two payments promised in 24 hours'
rows.prediction: If real, another promise-as-product; if not sourced by 11-03, this row is struck, append-only.
